facts.statement: Belemnacanthus fossils date to the Givetian stage.
The genus Belemnacanthus was described by Eastman in 1898.
The species lived during the Middle Devonian in the Eifel region of Germany.
facts.quote: from Givetian-aged strata of Middle Devonian Eifel, Germany

facts.statement: Before its correct identification, the fossil was successively described as a spine of an elasmobranch, an agnathan, and an antiarch.
facts.quote: Before the plate was identified as that of a holonematid, the plate of B. giganteus had been successively described as a tremendous spine of an elasmobranch, an agnathan, and lastly, the plate of an antiarch

facts.statement: Belemnacanthus belongs to the family Holonematidae.
Belemnacanthus is classified within the class Placodermi.
